name: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
summary: Learning and inference on time series can pose significant statistical challenges, including autocorrelated observations, distribution shift over time, and the curse of dimensionality. These challenges complicate the practical application of causal discovery algorithms, which already suffer from high computational and sample complexity in the general case.
